text: What shall it be?
zh: 来点什么？

text:
Do you want a fresh beer?
Or maybe a glass of the finest wine from the academy?
zh:
要来杯新鲜的啤酒吗？
还是来一杯学院出品的上等葡萄酒？

text: Besides drinks, I can also tell you a lot about the capital.
zh: 除了酒水，我还能给你讲讲王都的种种见闻。

text: Is this your tavern?
zh: 这是你的酒馆吗？

text: Do you have any news?
zh: 有什么新鲜事吗？

text: Where do you get your wine from?
zh: 你们的葡萄酒是从哪儿进的？

text: Where did you get the wine with the honey flavor?
zh: 那种带蜂蜜味的葡萄酒是从哪儿弄来的？

text: Show me your wares.
zh: 让我看看你的货。

text: See you!
zh: 回见！

text:
Nope.
I am just working here.
zh:
不是。
我只是在这里打工。

text: Baron Frestek bought this inn some time ago from Rair and made some renovations.
zh: 前段时间弗雷斯泰克男爵从莱尔手里买下了这家旅店，还翻修了一番。

text: Let me think...
zh: 让我想想……

text:
Not yet.
Come back later.
zh:
暂时没有。
过阵子再来吧。

text: Pst... Listen up.
zh: 嘘……听好了。

text: See that drunk guy over there?
zh: 看到那边那个醉汉了吗？

text: Lately, he has been mumbling about the dungeon of the castle.
zh: 最近他老是在嘟囔城堡地牢的事。

text:
For an adventurer like you, this might be interesting.
I don't know if it's true, though.
zh:
对你这样的冒险者来说，这也许挺有意思。
不过是真是假我就不知道了。

text: Only the best for you!
zh: 给你的自然是最好的！

text: I don't buy the wine myself, it's not my tavern.
zh: 酒不是我进的，这又不是我的酒馆。

text:
Baron Frestek is in charge of the inventory.
I actually only serve the wine.
zh:
存货都是弗雷斯泰克男爵在管。
我其实只负责端酒。

text:
Oh, you'll have to ask Baron Frestek.
He often receives the fine wines as gifts or buys them from other collectors.
zh:
哦，这你得去问弗雷斯泰克男爵。
那些上等好酒常常是别人送他的，或是他从其他藏家手里买来的。
